abstract: We give a fully constructive result for the transverse–traceless (TT) graviton sector of Modal Triplet Theory (MTT) under the spectral proper–time (SPT) damping mechanism. Assuming bounded geometry on a finite time slab (or bounded coordinate domain), we use a completely monotone proper–time filter with a positive proper–time gap \tau_0>0 to define a filtered covariance C satisfying a Gaussian ultraviolet bound \widehat C(k)\lesssim e^{-\tau_0|k|^2}/(|k|^2+\lambda_\ast). For local analytic interactions (including finite truncations of the TT-expanded Einstein–Hilbert density), we prove existence of the Euclidean functional integral, analyticity in a cardioid domain, and Borel summability of connected Schwinger functions via the Loop Vertex Expansion (BKAR forest formula) and a Nevanlinna–Sokal remainder bound. This provides a nonperturbative definition (via Borel sum) of the SPT-filtered TT sector and supplies the constructive core needed for a fully UV-controlled treatment of the physical TT sector within the MTT quantum gravity framework.
